Computers are dumb. They need explicit instructions. In fact, they need explicit instructions for everything they do, all the way down to the most basic tasks. Even something that seems simple, like adding two numbers, involves many steps. The computer doesn’t know what “2” or “4” are to begin with, only long strings of 1s and 0s. Then it has to know what “+” means. Then it has to know how to arrive at the result. Then it has to know what “6” is. Then it has to know what “=” means. Then it has to know how to display all this on the screen in the form “2 + 4 = 6”. And no computer knows how to do any of this on its own, out of the box.
